newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX says receives CFTC okay on Cusiana delivery.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX says receives CFTC okay on Cusiana delivery.

text.p: The New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) said Wednesday it received approval from the Commodity Futures Trading Commission to allow deliveries of Cusiana crude against its light, sweet crude contract.
As a result NYMEX was to adjust the premiums and discounts applied to the foreign crudes delivered against the contract.

The new differentials include 30 cents per barrel discounts for Brent blend and Oseberg crude, a 35 cts per barrel discount for delivery of Forties blend crude, a 40 cts per barrel premium payable for delivery of Bonny Light crude, and a 15 cts per barrel premium for delivery of Cusiana crude.
Currently, the buyer receives a 30 cts per barrel discount on delivery of Brent, Forties and Oseberg, and pays a 60 cts per barrel premium for delivery of Bonny Light.
NYMEX said it will implement the changes starting with the July 1997 contract.
